defects: Plan adds retries without preserving request bytes for replay. Current forwarding passes one-shot `request.body` directly to upstream fetch; second POST after 502/503 can use consumed/locked stream or send no body.
Plan classifies upstream-provider loss as model outcome when proxy stays live. Upstream is listed as runtime dependency, so its loss must be infrastructure failure, never subject result.
Plan has no environment contract for its test/control phases.
Plan lacks foreign-runtime inventory and real-agent target-environment control.
